subject: Poe
text: Poes are defeated by slicing them with the sword or shooting them with arrows after they appear, and the real purple Poe can be spotted by an extra twirl.

evidence.quote: The Poes can be defeated by waiting for them to fully appear, then slicing them with the sword or shooting them with arrows.  The purple Poe makes copies of itself, but the real Poe is easy to spot, because it adds an extra twirl when it appears.

subject: Stalfos
text: Stalfos will regenerate if not dispatched quickly, so damage all of them before killing one.

evidence.quote: The Stalfos will regenerate themselves if you're not quick, so damage all of them before killing one, or they'll raise themselves up again.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: To defeat Phantom Ganon, shoot the copy emerging from a painting in a purple haze with an arrow, then reflect his energy balls back at him and hit him with the sword.

evidence.quote: To defeat the menacing Phantom Ganon: In the first phase, two copies of Ganon run at you on his horse from two of the paintings.  One of them emerges from the painting in a purple haze; shoot that Ganon with an arrow.  When you've done that enough, Ganon will float around the room.  Reflect his energy ball back at him until he's hit, then pound on him with your sword until he dies.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Climb up the vines on the right and shoot the Gold Skulltula with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Go right and climb up the vines, then shoot the Gold Skulltula with your Hookshot (#1).

subject: Small Key
text: Jump across at the top of the vines to find a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote: At the top of the vines, jump over and get the key from the chest.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located near one of the main doors.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula (#2) near one of the main doors.

subject: Small Key
text: Defeat the enemies past the north hallway to collect a key from the chest.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemies and get the key from the chest.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: Defeat the enemy to obtain the dungeon map from the chest.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemy and get the map from the chest, and go to the next room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Hookshot to the chest on the small island and shoot the nearby Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote: Hookshot to the chest on the small island, then shoot the nearby Gold Skulltula (#3) on the wall.

subject: Small Key
text: Go down into the drained well to find a key at the end of the path.

evidence.quote: Go down the drained well, and get the key at the end of the path.

subject: Block puzzle
text: Push and pull the blue block until it sinks, climb the ladder to push the red block, then push the red block from above until it sinks into the floor.

evidence.quote: follow the arrows to a blue block, then pull and push it until it sinks into the ground.  Go through where the block was blocking the path and climb up the ladder.  Push the red block until it stops, then go back around and climb up the blue block, and push the red block until it sinks.

subject: Fairy Bow
text: Defeat the enemies in the room to obtain the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote: Go down to the next room, kill the enemies and get the Fairy Bow.

subject: Small Key
text: Shoot the pictures from far away and defeat the red Poe to obtain a key.

evidence.quote: shoot the pictures by standing far away, then kill the red Poe and get the key.

subject: Compass
text: Shoot the pictures and defeat the blue Poe to obtain the compass.

evidence.quote: Shoot the pictures and kill the blue Poe, then get the compass.

subject: Boss Key
text: Drop down in the untwisted hallway room to open the chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Drop down and get the Boss Key from the chest, then drop down the hole.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Jump across to the white ledge with hearts to defeat the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote: Jump across to the white ledge with hearts, and kill the Gold Skulltula (#4) on the wall.

subject: Small Key
text: Defeat the enemies in the side room to obtain a key from the chest.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemies and get the key from the chest.

subject: Eye switch
text: Shoot the frozen eye switch with an arrow through the center flames to twist the hallway.

evidence.quote: Shoot the eye with an arrow that passes through the center flames, then go back through the newly-twisted hallway.

subject: Block puzzle
text: Shoot the picture, assemble the blocks within the time limit, and kill the green Poe.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the picture, put the blocks together in the time limit, then kill 
  the green Poe.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Push the rotating walls in the basement to find a Gold Skulltula behind a big Skulltula in an alcove.

evidence.quote:
Push the walls around- one of the holes has a big Skulltula and a Gold 
  Skulltula (#5) behind it.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: Return to the Temple of Time after clearing the Forest Temple to learn the Prelude of Light from Sheik and travel between Young and Adult Link at will.

evidence.quote: Go back to the Temple of Time after beating the Forest Temple, and Sheik will teach you this song.  You can now go back and forth between Young and Adult Link at will.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: Defeat Dead Hand with your sword in the Bottom of the Well to receive the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Go through the crawlspace.  Defeat Dead Hand with your sword to get the Lens of Truth.

subject: Small Key
text: Use the Lens of Truth to find a hidden wall alcove with a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote: Use the Lens of Truth to find a tiny hidden room in the wall in front of you, and get the key inside the chest there.

subject: Small Key
text: Use the Lens of Truth along the right-hand corridor to find a hidden room with a key in a chest.

evidence.quote: Now go along the right-hand corridor and use the Lens of Truth to find another tiny room with a key in a chest.

subject: Small Key
text: Light the torches to reveal coffins, one of which contains a key.

evidence.quote: Light the torches to uncover the coffins- there is a key inside one of them.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Go through the left-hand locked door in the central room to destroy the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote: Go through the left-hand locked door, and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Use the Lens of Truth to cross the invisible platform to the left and defeat the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth to go across the invisible platform to the left, and 
kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall here.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Head through the corner crawlspace at the end of the right-hand corridor, unlock the door, use the Lens of Truth past the pits, and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote:
Go along the 
right-hand corridor to its end, and go east through the crawlspace in the 
corner.  Go through the locked door on the other side.  Use the Lens of Truth
to avoid the pits, and go to the next room.  Kill the Gold Skulltula on the
wall here.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Stand on the log in Zora's River as Young Link and play the Song of Storms for the frogs to obtain a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Midway up the river before the bridge, stand on the log sticking out of the water.  Pull out your Ocarina and play the Song of Storms for the frogs to get a Heart Piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Play five songs for the frogs at Zora's River and then follow their tune on the Ocarina to earn a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Play Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, Song of Time, and Sun Song 
in front of the same frogs for rupees.  Then, follow the tune they give you on
your Ocarina, and they will give you another Heart Piece.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Play the treasure chest game at night as Young Link and use the Lens of Truth to claim the Heart Piece at the end.

evidence.quote:
Go to the Market as Young Link and change it to night, then play the treasure
chest game in the southwest corner of the village.  Use the Lens of Truth to
see through the chests, get the keys, and get the Heart Piece at the end.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Play the Song of Storms next to the tree where Talon was sleeping at Hyrule Castle to reveal a hole containing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Enter the Hyrule Castle area as Young Link and go over to where you first met
the sleeping Talon.  Go to the nearby tree and play the Song of Storms next to
it to open a secret hole.  There is a Gold Skulltula inside.

subject: 40 Arrow Quiver
text: Win the archery shooting gallery game in Kakariko Village as Adult Link to receive the 40 Arrow Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: - Get 40 Arrow Quiver (Kakariko Village) At the spot where the building was under construction as Young Link, enter the new building as Adult Link, play the archery game and win to get this upgrade.

subject: Bottle
text: Catch 10 Big Poes from Hyrule Field in bottles and sell them to the Poe dealer in the Market to obtain the fourth Bottle.

evidence.quote:
Collect 10 Big Poes from around Hyrule 
Field in bottles and sell them to him to get the fourth Bottle.

subject: Big Poe
text: Shoot Big Poes twice with arrows before they disappear to kill them.

evidence.quote:
To kill the 
Big Poes, shoot them twice with arrows before they disappear.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Jump across to the ledge on the left in Gerudo Fortress at night to find a Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote:
Jump over to the ledge on the left from here- there will be a Gold
Skulltula on the wall, at night of course.

subject: Gerudo Membership Card
text: Save the last carpenter in Gerudo Fortress and the Gerudo swordsman will reward Link with the membership card.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the guard as 
she approaches, then go through and save the last carpenter.  Afterwards, the
Gerudo swordsman will give you the membership card.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Score 1,000 points in the horseback archery game during the daytime at Gerudo Fortress to earn a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Score 
1,000 points to get a Heart Piece.  Keep in mind that you can only play the 
archery game during the day.

subject: 50 Arrow Quiver
text: Score 1,500 points in the horseback archery game to earn the 50 Arrow Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: - Get 50 Arrow Quiver (Gerudo Fortress) Score 1,500 points on the archery game to get this upgrade.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Drop a bug onto the soft soil patch near the Fire Temple in Death Mountain Crater to uncover a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
There is a nearby soft soil that you can use a bug on to fish
out a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil as Young Link, then ride the bean platform as Adult Link to reach the Heart Piece on the top ledge.

evidence.quote:
Plant a Magic Bean in this same soft soil spot, then come back as Adult Link.
Ride the bean platform and get the Heart Piece on the top ledge.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Ride the bean platform around until it nears a hole in the wall, then jump off to collect the Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Ride this same bean platform around until it nears a hole in the wall with a
Heart Piece.  Jump off at that point to get it.

subject: Big Poe
text: The 10 Big Poes in Hyrule Field appear south of the Market, by Lon Lon Ranch, east of the ranch at the y-shaped wall, south of Kakariko Village, east of the Gerudo Valley path, west of Kokiri Forest, in the southeast field of trees, and in the northwest trees.

evidence.quote:
Collect 10 Big Poes from around Hyrule 
Field in bottles and sell them to him to get the fourth Bottle.  To kill the 
Big Poes, shoot them twice with arrows before they disappear.  Locations of 
the Big Poes in Hyrule Field: 1 just south of the Market, near the sign; 1 
next to the entrance to Lon Lon Ranch; 1 at the y-shaped stone wall east of 
the ranch; 1 just south of the entrance to Kakariko Village; 2 just east of 
the brown path that leads to the Gerudo Valley, 1 west of Kokiri Forest, near 
the grey stone; 2 in the very southeast corner in the field of trees; and 1 
in the northwest corner in the field of trees there.
